summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating data aggregation processes. A new aggregation needs to be deployed to the beta environment while keeping the old version live in production. Furthermore, a full reaggregation of all companies is required for the period starting May 1, 2024, specifically targeting the beta environment.

The updated dataset includes a complete forecast and features a 'forecast percent' metric, defined as the proportion of forecasted sessions within total traffic. This feature was planned alongside a new median dwell time calculation.
decisions: Deploy new aggregation to beta environment; keep old version on production
Reaggregate all companies for the period starting 2024-05-01 in the beta environment with updated scripts and forecast data
action_items: Complete the reaggregation of all company data to the beta environment within an hour (initial commitment)
